title: Load and Modify Pretrained ResNet
description: Load a pretrained ResNet18, replace its classifier for 5 classes, and verify architecture.
problemStatement:
Write code that:
1. Loads a pretrained ResNet18 using `models.resnet18(weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT)`.
2. Replaces the final fully connected layer (`fc`) with a new `nn.Linear` that outputs 5 classes.
3. Freezes all parameters except those of the new `fc` layer.
4. Prints the number of trainable parameters (sum of `p.numel()` for parameters with `requires_grad=True`) in the format: "Trainable parameters: X".

The output must match exactly (X being the integer count).
hints: After replacing fc, loop through `model.parameters()` and set `requires_grad=False`. Then set `model.fc.weight.requires_grad = True` and bias similarly, but they are True by default anyway. So just freeze all first, then they become False, then set fc to True.
Count using `sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)`.
expectedOutput: Trainable parameters: 2565 (or 5*512 + 5 = 2565? Actually ResNet18 fc.in_features=512, so 512*5 + 5 = 2565)
solutionCode:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torchvision.models as models

model = models.resnet18(weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT)
for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False
model.fc = nn.Linear(model.fc.in_features, 5)
trainable_params = sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
print(f"Trainable parameters: {trainable_params}")
